max_seq_len_status: APPROVED. Selected from the real Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct tokenizer audit run in Google Colab against data/sft_train.jsonl (280 examples) -- see data/token_length_audit.json. Measured combined (prompt+target) token length: min 175, median 193, p90 204, p95 207, p99 211.2, max 214. 256 preserves all 280 training examples and their complete assistant target (0 truncated at 256, vs. 142/280 truncated at 192 and 280/280 at 128) with modest headroom over the true max of 214; 384 and 512 were rejected as adding activation-memory cost with no data-preservation benefit over 256. Human-approved before being set here.

lora.target_modules_status: PROPOSED capacity choice, not a proven requirement. Verify these are the real module names for Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct via model.named_modules() at load time (train_qlora.py does this and asserts on mismatch). Attention-only (q_proj, v_proj) is a defensible narrower alternative for a mostly stylistic/formatting task; the broader attention+MLP set trades more trainable parameters for more capacity, to be measured against actual eval results, not assumed superior.

quantization.bnb_4bit_compute_dtype_status: The NVIDIA T4 has no native bf16 support -- float16 is required here, not a stylistic choice. src/resource_monitor.check_hardware() verifies this against the detected GPU at startup.

deliberate_oom.rationale: Intended to genuinely exceed the T4 memory budget via activation memory scaling with batch_size x seq_len^2 x num_layers once gradient checkpointing is off. Raise these further if this exact config does not OOM on the allocated Colab GPU -- the goal is a real torch.cuda.OutOfMemoryError, not these specific numbers.
